assets.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: fixed photograph-like image for a kindergarten shape-recognition worksheet. Create a realistic photograph of one circular wall clock mounted on a plain light plaster wall in a familiar home. Landscape 3:2 composition. Camera directly in front of the clock, centered, so the outer clock face is a true circle, not an ellipse. The clock fills about two thirds of image height, entirely within the frame with generous clear margins. The clock has a simple dark circular rim with visible thickness, a pale face, two plain clock hands and small tick marks, but NO numerals, words, logos or printed text. Soft daylight, authentic metal or wood rim texture, subtle cast shadow on the wall, believable physical materials. Sparse background with no distracting additional objects. This must look like a photographed tangible household clock, not vector artwork, cartoon, icon, flat shape, schematic or 3D rendering. Do not add labels, arrows, borders or answer annotations.

Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: fixed photograph-like image for a kindergarten shape-recognition worksheet. Create a realistic photograph of one unmistakably square household window set into a plain light plaster wall. Landscape 3:2 composition. Camera exactly straight on and level: the outside perimeter of the full window frame must be a precise square, equal width and height, with four clear straight edges and right angles. The complete square frame fills about two thirds of image height and is surrounded by visible wall on all four sides. A simple single pane of clear glass, no muntins, no internal grid. Show convincing wooden frame thickness, a shallow wall recess, subtle glass reflections and a softly blurred garden beyond. Natural daylight and realistic materials establish that this is a real physical window. No curtains, shutters or protruding sill to obscure or change the square outer boundary. No people, text, logos, diagrams, arrows or answer marks. It must look photographed, not illustrated, vector, cartoon, icon or 3D rendered.

Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: fixed photograph-like image for a kindergarten shape-recognition worksheet. Create a realistic photograph looking exactly vertically down at a simple wooden dining table on a neutral indoor floor. Landscape 3:2 composition. The tabletop is visibly rectangular, about 1.7 times as wide as it is tall, with four long straight edges and four crisp right-angle corners, no rounded corners, no oval outline. The entire tabletop is visible with generous floor margin on every side; no perspective convergence or trapezoidal distortion. Authentic wood grain, a visible thin physical edge and natural shadows underneath. A small portion of one plain dining chair just outside the table at a short edge may establish familiar dining-room context, but must not overlap or hide any tabletop edge. Keep the tabletop empty. Bright natural daylight, believable physical household furniture, no text, logos, labels, arrows, grid, dimensions or answer annotations. Photograph-like, not vector artwork, illustration, isolated geometric icon, or 3D rendering.

Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: fixed photograph-like image for a kindergarten shape-recognition worksheet. Create a realistic photograph of one plain triangular fabric pennant mounted flat against a light wall on a slim wooden staff. Landscape 3:2 composition. Camera directly frontal; the entire colored fabric is a clean triangle with exactly three straight sides and three sharp corners, one vertical side at the staff and one point extending right. The fabric is held taut and planar with no folds altering the outline. Its triangular silhouette is obvious, centered and completely visible with generous margins. Fine woven cloth texture and a subtle stitched hem show tangible material; visible wood grain on the staff and soft realistic shadows establish a physical household or classroom item. One solid warm fabric color, no patterns. No letters, numbers, emblems, brands, logos, people, labels, arrows or diagram annotations. Natural daylight, convincingly photographic, not cartoon, vector, icon or 3D rendering.

Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: fixed photograph-like image for a kindergarten shape-recognition worksheet. Create a realistic macro photograph of an actual natural beeswax honeycomb, viewed directly straight into the openings, perpendicular to the comb surface. Landscape 3:2 composition. A central open cell and its six immediate neighboring open cells are fully visible; a few partial cells continue to the edges so this clearly depicts a real honeycomb. Each opening has six clear approximately straight sides and six recognizable corners, with the central cell particularly close to a regular hexagon. Realistic golden wax wall thickness, fine organic wax texture, subtle depth and natural shading inside the empty cells. Keep the openings unobstructed: no bees, honey, caps, hands or tools. Bright soft natural illumination, sharp main cells, restrained background. The educational target is the shape of one cell opening. Do not isolate a bare hexagon; preserve the tangible honeycomb context. No text, labels, arrows, highlighted outlines, diagram borders or answer annotations. Must look like a real photograph, not a vector pattern, cartoon, infographic or 3D rendering.
